# RuleSet

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A named, reusable, ordered collection of rules.

Appears at: `/rule_sets`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_child_suppress` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Whether a group below the one that assigns this rule set may disable one of its rules with `suppress_inherited` (#37). Unset means `true` for an allowlist or a baseline and `false` for every other kind. A mandatory rule set can never be suppressed (`suppress_not_allowed`). |
| `band` | integer | no |  | 0 to 255; format `uint8` | 1.0.0 | The `first_match` band of the hierarchy level that assigned this rule set (#37): rules of a lower band come first, whatever their `order`. The hierarchy writes it into an effective policy and replaces any value an authored policy gives, so a local administrator cannot move a rule set ahead of global policy. 0, the default, outside a hierarchy. |
| `category_path` | string | no |  | matches `^[^/]+(/[^/]+)?$` | 1.0.0 | The category, as `Category` or `Category/Subcategory`: each part 1 to 64 characters, trimmed, with no `/` or control characters. Assigning a category assigns every rule set library in it (#37). |
| `description` | string | no |  | at most 4096 characters | 1.0.0 | Free-text description, at most 4096 characters. |
